verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. The research record now states that all four configurations were re-run end-to-end after the SRX entity-reference and bounded XML-normalizer fixes, identifies the corrected run as the source of the 72.22%/143 result, and no longer claims bit-identical comparator equivalence. It quantifies the remaining GML-comparator exposure, weakens the rank to 2nd-or-3rd where that uncertainty matters, and shows that the behind-the-leader conclusion remains valid across the stated bound. The added comparator tests exercise entity preservation, malformed-input fail-closed behavior, escaping, empty elements, ordering, and non-vacuous inequality cases; the cache self-test exercises the real script and rejects count-preserving edits, missing proofs, and mismatched pins. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident in the diff.
